inlines.v: WOOLLY, adjective 1. Consisting of wool; as a woolly covering; a woolly fleece. 2. Resembling wool; as woolly hair. 3. Clothed with wool; as woolly breeders. 4. In botany, clothed with a pubescence resembling wool.
